title: The GTA 6 Money Cheat Trap
yt_title: Don't Use The GTA 6 Money Cheat Yet ❌ #shorts
description:
The $250,000 money cheat in GTA 6 only works after the story, and you can't save while it is active. Some story missions need cash to start, so earn it the real way.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GTA6Money

lines.text: Thinking of using the GTA 6 money cheat? Read this first.
It gives you two hundred fifty thousand dollars.
But it only works after you finish the story.
And you can't save your game while it's active.
Some story missions won't even start until you have enough cash.
So early on, you have to earn it the real way.
How are you making money right now?
